note: Whole files exempt from scripts/check-test-prose.mjs, for source that works on typographic characters rather than writing with them. Paths only. A substring exemption is not available on purpose: the previous allowlist named the em dash itself, which exempted every line containing one and let the gate pass while roughly fifteen hundred accumulated. If a legitimate shape keeps tripping the gate, add it to KEEP in the script so it stays exempt everywhere, rather than exempting a whole file.
